import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentAffineOpen

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

/-! The canonical affine chart identifies sections on the chart with sections
on its image.  This wrapper transports that additive isomorphism across the
image equality supplied by `IsAffineOpen`. -/

noncomputable def affineChartSectionsEquiv
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ((Spec Γ(X, U)), (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens)) :=
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv.hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Module Γ(X, U) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback hU.fromSpec).obj F, ⊤) :=
      Module.compHom _ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv.hom
    Γ(F.restrict hU.fromSpec, ⊤) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(F, U) := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ((Spec Γ(X, U)), (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens)) :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv.hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Module Γ(X, U) Γ(F.restrict hU.fromSpec, ⊤) :=
    Module.compHom _ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv.hom
  let hImg : hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) = U := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
    exact hU.opensRange_fromSpec
  let α : Γ(F.restrict hU.fromSpec, ⊤) ≅
      Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens)) :=
    F.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec ⊤
  let β : Γ(F, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens)) ≅ Γ(F, U) :=
    (F.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso hImg.symm).op)
  let γ : Γ(F.restrict hU.fromSpec, ⊤) ≅ Γ(F, U) := α ≪≫ β
  refine
    { toFun := fun x => γ.hom x
      invFun := fun y => γ.inv y
      left_inv := by
        intro x
        change γ.inv (γ.hom x) = x
        exact γ.hom_inv_id_apply x
      right_inv := by
        intro y
        change γ.hom (γ.inv y) = y
        exact γ.inv_hom_id_apply y
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        exact map_add _ _ _
      map_smul' := ?_ }
  · intro r x
    change γ.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom r • x) = r • γ.hom x
    change β.hom (α.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom r • x)) = r • β.hom (α.hom x)
    rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply]
    change β.hom
      (((hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom r)) •
        α.hom x) = _
    change (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom hImg.symm).op).hom
      (((hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom r)) • α.hom x) = _
    rw [F.map_smul]
    have h_appLE : hU.fromSpec.appLE U ⊤
        (le_of_eq hU.fromSpec_preimage_self.symm) = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv := by
      simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE, hU.fromSpec_app_self, ← Functor.map_comp]
    have h_combine :
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫ (hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv =
          X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq hImg)).op := by
      rw [← h_appLE]
      exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv hU.fromSpec (le_of_eq hU.fromSpec_preimage_self.symm)
    have h_key :
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫ (hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv ≫
            X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hImg.symm).op = 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, h_combine, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
      simp
    have hr := congrArg (fun q => q r) h_key
    have hr' : (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hImg.symm).op).hom
        ((hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom r)) = r := by
      change (ConcreteCategory.hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫ (hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv ≫
          X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hImg.symm).op)) r = r at hr
      change (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hImg.symm).op).hom
          ((hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom r)) = r at hr
      exact hr
    change _ • (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom hImg.symm).op).hom (α.hom x) =
      r • (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom hImg.symm).op).hom (α.hom x)
    rw [hr']

@[simp]
theorem affineChartSectionsEquiv_apply
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (x : Γ(F.restrict hU.fromSpec, ⊤)) :
    affineChartSectionsEquiv F hU x =
      (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (show hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ
        (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) = U by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
          exact hU.opensRange_fromSpec).symm).op).hom
        ((F.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec ⊤).hom x) := rfl

end MilneLib
